title: GrimStats Client
body:
# GrimStats Client

A clientside companion for [GrimStats](https://stats.grimwald.xyz) servers. It brings the
server's leaderboards into your game, right where the vanilla statistics already live.

## Features

- **Rank badges** on the statistics screen. Your server-wide rank sits next to each stat, with
  gold, silver, and bronze for the podium.
- **Leaderboard tooltips**. Hover any stat on the General, Items, or Mobs tab to see the top
  players and where you place.
- **Server Rankings screen**. Browse a live leaderboard for any stat, with search across every
  stat type including modded ones.
- **Players and profiles**. A sortable roster and per-player pages with combat stats, K/D, most
  killed mobs, top blocks mined, and a distance breakdown.
- **In-game config**. Set it up from a settings screen, ModMenu, or a keybind. No file editing.

## Setup

Install the mod and join a server running GrimStats. It finds the API automatically from the
server address. If the dashboard runs elsewhere, set the URL with `/grimstatsc url <address>` or
in the config screen. Private servers may need an API token, which goes in the same place.

## Requires

- Fabric Loader and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional, for the config button

Clientside only. Safe to use on any server; it stays completely quiet when no GrimStats server
is present.
